The '''Krenher Sector Station''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Krenhner sector/Legends|Krenhner sector]]. This space station was the closest New Republic outpost to [[Gmar Askilon]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ejagga Pakkpekatt]] sent the [[Marauder (Warrior-class)|''Marauder'']] to the station after the [[Teljkon Vagabond]] fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
